Job description:
Who we are About Stripe Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career. About the team Abuse Operations is the front-line incident response and remediation function handling active product abuse and fraud impacting Stripe and its merchants. This multi-disciplinary group, spanning Incident Managers, Investigators, Forward Deployed Security Engineers, and Data Scientists, neutralizes active attacks, gathers requirements for operational tooling, and leads incidents. The team  works directly with impacted merchants to resolve technical incidents and policy abuse rapidly. Operating primarily across Eastern, Pacific and Western European time zones, these team members regularly coordinate with global stakeholders across the world. What you’ll do You'll play a critical role in safeguarding our financial ecosystem by investigating high-risk accounts and identifying complex patterns of fraud during incidents. You will lead incident response for product abuse and fraud events, conducting deep-dive analyses to identify root causes. By collaborating cross-functionally, you will drive improvements that enhance our fraud detection and prevention strategies at scale. Your expertise will be essential in automating response processes through agentic approaches, allowing us to safeguard merchants and neutralize threats with speed and precision. Responsibilities Investigate, mitigate, and remediate urgent fraud incidents (e.g., ATO, card testing), utilizing FT3-mapped detection and signals enrichment to reduce uncertainty and accelerate response. As part of incidents, analyze high-risk accounts to identify fraudulent merchants, card testing, account takeovers, and other fraud vectors, classifying them using FT3 (Fraud Taxonomy 3.0) to standardize threat intelligence. Lead incident root cause analyses to identify gaps in current systems and strategies, leveraging the FT3 framework, data-driven model to drive enhancements and process improvements for emerging fraud risks. Streamline incident response capabilities, ensuring the tooling and processes are clear, accurate and efficient Work cross-functionally with security, fraud and data science teams to build agentic solutions for responding to abuse incidents at scale Effectively communicate cross-functionally with legal and policy teams to assess and mitigate risks, while demonstrating strong problem-solving under pressure. Collaborate effectively with teammates, leading projects, mentoring others, and developing and championing quality standards within the team Who you are We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement. Minimum requirements 5+ years of experience conducting incident response in security, product abuse or trust domains 5+ years experience analyzing large data sets to solve problems and/or building models with a behavioral approach to fraud detection B.S. or M.S. Computer Science or related field, or equivalent experience Expert knowledge of Python and SQL, and familiarity with other programming languages Existing experience with log analysis (e.g. first or third party applications, system / data access, event logs), network security, digital forensics, and incident response investigations Ability to communicate results clearly and focus on impact Ability to think creatively and holistically about reducing risk in a complex environment Preferred qualifications An adversarial mindset, understanding the goals, behaviors, and TTPs of threat actors. Experience with engineering, data processing and analysis tools (e.g. Databricks, Trino, etc.) Familiarity with common open-source frameworks for big data processing and/or data science (PySpark, Pandas, Sci-kit Learn, etc.) Experience with tactical threat intelligence and/or hunting for sophisticated threat actors in an enterprise environment Ability to proactively challenge the status quo by leveraging data and taking a user-centric approach to address complex product integrity challenges

Job description:
Who we are About Stripe Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career. About the Team The Account Management team at Bridge is dedicated to the growth, retention, and expansion of key customers. Our Scaled Account Management team focuses on driving measurable expansion across a broad portfolio of mid-market and high-growth customers through data-driven strategies, efficient processes, and strong cross-functional partnership. What You'll Do As a Scaled Account Manager at Bridge you will own a book of existing accounts and be responsible for expanding revenue, identifying product gaps and driving product adoption, preventing churn and ensuring renewals at scale. You will combine consultative selling with volume playbooks, prioritization based on quantitative signals, and hands-on execution to identify and close upsell opportunities across your territory. As Bridge continues to develop within Stripe’s Money Management organization, you will also drive your customers’ adoption of additional features available through Stripe. Responsibilities - Own a book of existing accounts and drive revenue growth through additional usage, upsells, cross-sells, and renewals. - Develop and execute scalable go-to-market strategies that increase revenue per account and accelerate product adoption across your portfolio. - Use data and quantitative analysis to prioritize accounts and identify the highest-impact expansion opportunities. - Generate leads through targeted outreach, research, and campaign execution; manage high-velocity deal cycles from qualification to close. - Build strong relationships with customer stakeholders to understand business priorities, surface pain points, and tailor Bridge solutions. - Lead commercial negotiations and renewals to expand and retain customer revenue. - Identify churn signals in your book and implement strategies to prevent revenue losses. - Coordinate with product, success, risk, and operations teams to solve complex customer needs and ensure a great user experience. - Translate customer feedback into actionable product and process improvements to better serve scaled customer segments. Who You Are -5–8 years of full sales cycle or account management experience focused on existing business accounts; experience managing a large book of accounts or high-velocity portfolio strongly preferred. - Strong analytical skills with experience using data to prioritize accounts, build business cases, and track outcomes. - Comfortable understanding technical product requirements and articulating solutions across multiple technology products. - Demonstrated ability to close upsell opportunities and manage complex pricing or commercial negotiations. - Excellent operational acumen and proven ability to manage time and prioritize across a high-volume territory. - Highly motivated, persistent, and effective in ambiguous, fast-paced environments. - Superior written and verbal communication skills. - Willingness and ability to work in-office in New York or San Francisco at least three days per week. Preferred Qualifications - Previous experience at a high-growth payments, fintech, crypto, or technology company. - Experience with CRM tools, Excel, and basic SQL or a demonstrated comfort with data tools and analysis. - Background in working cross-functionally with product, risk, and operations teams to deliver outcomes for customers. Why Bridge Join a team that values clear thinking, quantitative rigor, and customer obsession. At Bridge you’ll own meaningful customer outcomes, operate with autonomy, and have the opportunity to shape how we scale revenue across high-potential accounts.

About the team The Money as a Service (MaaS) team helps businesses build and scale financial products using Stripe’s infrastructure. Stripe Issuing enables businesses to create and manage virtual and physical card programs, while Stripe Treasury provides financial accounts and money-management capabilities that platforms can embed within their products. Together, Issuing and Treasury help businesses create integrated financial experiences—from receiving and holding funds to moving money and managing card spend. Our users include high-growth startups, fintechs, software platforms, and enterprises developing new embedded-finance products and business models. Product Sales is a team of deep functional and technical specialists who lead and advise on Stripe’s most strategic and complex opportunities. We work closely with Account Executives, Product, Engineering, Solutions Architecture, Legal, Finance, and other partners to turn sophisticated financial infrastructure into meaningful outcomes for our users. What you’ll do As an Account Executive, Product focused on Issuing and Treasury, you will grow Stripe’s relationship with existing users by identifying new use cases, expanding product adoption, and helping users realize greater value from Stripe’s financial infrastructure. You will serve as a trusted product and commercial advisor, developing a deep understanding of each user’s business model, product roadmap, technical environment, and growth priorities. In partnership with core Account Executives, you will build multi-year account strategies, uncover whitespace, and lead complex expansion opportunities from initial discovery through activation and revenue realization. Responsibilities Identify and lead Issuing and Treasury expansion opportunities across existing Stripe users, including fintechs, software platforms, startups, and enterprises Build and execute strategic account plans that connect users’ business priorities with relevant Stripe products and capabilities Develop trusted relationships with executive, commercial, product, and technical stakeholders Lead customer discovery, product discussions, business-case development, commercial negotiations, and deal strategy Partner closely with core Account Executives to align on account strategy, executive relationships, opportunity ownership, and sequencing Help users expand into new business units, geographies, products, and embedded-finance use cases Coordinate cross-functional teams through solution design, pricing, contracting, implementation, activation, and growth Become an internal and customer-facing expert on Stripe Issuing and Treasury, relevant use cases, integration models, and the competitive landscape Work with Product and Engineering to synthesize user feedback, identify recurring product needs, and inform Stripe’s roadmap and go-to-market strategy Represent product capabilities accurately and develop creative solutions without overcommitting Stripe’s roadmap Create scalable go-to-market playbooks, AI-supported workflows, and process improvements in partnership with Sales, Product, Marketing, and Technical Services Maintain an accurate forecast and use data and AI tools to prioritize opportunities and improve performance Who you are We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement. Minimum requirements 7+ years of customer-facing sales experience at a leading technology, financial infrastructure, fintech, or payments company Experience with issuing or treasury focused products is a plus A track record of meeting or exceeding quota in a complex B2B sales environment Experience growing existing customer relationships through cross-sell, upsell, product adoption, or account expansion Demonstrated ability to lead complex, multi-stakeholder opportunities involving executives, Product, Engineering, Finance, Legal, Procurement, and other teams Strong commercial judgment, including experience developing business cases, articulating value, structuring deals, and leading negotiations Ability to understand sophisticated technical products and explain them clearly to both business and technical audiences Experience building trusted-advisor relationships with senior business leaders Proven ability to build collaborative relationships and influence cross-functional partners without direct authority An entrepreneurial approach and comfort operating independently in an ambiguous, fast-moving environment Excellent verbal and written communication skills Strong analytical, organizational, and account-planning skill In office locations include: San Francisco and New York preferred. Chicago also available.

This role will work across Stripe’s global LPM portfolio while developing particular expertise in the payment preferences, market dynamics, and user opportunities most relevant to Australia and New Zealand, Japan, India, Singapore, and Southeast Asia. The portfolio and market emphasis will evolve as user needs and Stripe’s capabilities grow. What you’ll do As an Account Executive, Product focused on Local Payment Methods, you will be a quota-carrying product-sales overlay responsible for growing adoption and revenue across new and existing Stripe users. You will partner with Core Account Executives and Customer Success Managers throughout the sales cycle—from opportunity identification and discovery through business-case development, commercial negotiation, technical validation, implementation, activation, and expansion. You will help some of Stripe’s largest and most sophisticated users understand how regionally relevant payment methods can support conversion, customer choice, global expansion, and sustainable revenue growth for users and payment-method partners. You will develop deep knowledge of Stripe’s portfolio and the diverse payment behaviors that shape commerce across APAC, including bank-based payments, wallets, real-time payment experiences, and other market-specific methods. You are an adept salesperson who can engage in business and technical conversations at multiple levels of an organization. You are comfortable navigating product-led integrations and complex customer structures, and you can turn payment-method complexity into a clear commercial and technical path forward. You enjoy building value in competitive situations and creating scalable go-to-market motions from what you learn in the field. Responsibilities Deliver against an individual quota by driving adoption, payment volume, and revenue for Stripe’s local payment methods across APAC. Partner with Core Account Executives and Customer Success Managers to identify, qualify, develop, and close high-potential LPM opportunities across new and existing users. Build territory and account strategies that reflect local payment preferences and user expansion priorities across Australia and New Zealand, Japan, India, Singapore, Southeast Asia, and other priority APAC markets. Lead discovery with business, product, finance, and technical stakeholders to understand customer needs and recommend appropriate payment-method strategies. Develop customer-specific business cases that connect LPM adoption to conversion, customer choice, market entry, and revenue growth. Lead complex commercial discussions and coordinate with Partnerships and Deal teams when opportunities involve payment-method partners or bespoke commercial structures. Work with Solutions Architecture, Product, Engineering, and Post-Sales teams to translate user requirements into viable integration and launch plans. Guide users from initial evaluation through technical validation, implementation, activation, and post-launch expansion. Monitor adoption and payment volume after launch, identify barriers and whitespace, and coordinate with account teams on growth plans. Serve as an internal and customer-facing LPM expert, creating field enablement, account-planning guidance, and repeatable regional sales plays. Synthesize market intelligence and user feedback for Product, Engineering, Partnerships, and Marketing to help inform product and go-to-market priorities. Job description:
Who we are About Stripe Stripe builds financial infrastructure for businesses—from ambitious startups to global enterprises. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we’re building the tools that help businesses participate in and grow the global economy. About the team Stripe’s Crypto team is building financial infrastructure for a world where money moves as easily as information. Across Stripe, Bridge, and Privy, we help businesses build products powered by stablecoins, wallets, and programmable money movement. Open Issuance is central to that opportunity. Built by Bridge, a Stripe company, it enables businesses to launch and manage their own stablecoins. Alongside it, Open Standard—the independent organization behind Open USD (OUSD)—is building a shared stablecoin network with broad distribution and economics designed to benefit the businesses driving adoption.  We’re hiring one of the founding sellers of our Open Issuance go-to-market team. You’ll partner closely with Open Standard and teams across Stripe, Bridge, and Privy on a major strategic bet: challenging the stablecoin duopoly and giving businesses more choice, control, and participation in the economics of digital dollars. This is an opportunity to help build a market—not simply sell into an established one. What you’ll do You’ll own new-business development with high-potential businesses building the next generation of financial products. You’ll help founders, executives, and technical teams understand where stablecoins can create meaningful value, whether through adopting OUSD or launching their own stablecoin with Open Issuance. As a founding seller, you’ll shape the strategy as well as execute it. You’ll identify early customers, develop compelling commercial use cases, close complex deals, and turn those engagements into a repeatable sales motion. You should be equally comfortable opening doors, working through technical and commercial details, and creating structure where no playbook exists. Responsibilities Own a revenue target and the full sales lifecycle, from proactive prospecting and qualification through negotiation, closing, launch, and expansion. Build a net-new pipeline of companies, platforms, fintechs, and other businesses with strong potential to adopt OUSD or Open Issuance. Develop trusted relationships with founders, CEOs, CFOs, and product and engineering leaders, translating complex infrastructure into a clear business case. Partner closely with Open Standard to develop opportunities, coordinate customer engagements, and grow adoption of OUSD. Help customers evaluate opportunities across stablecoin issuance, global money movement, treasury, payouts, and emerging AI and agentic-commerce use cases. Lead technically and commercially complex sales in partnership with Solutions Architecture, Product, Engineering, Legal, Risk, and Compliance. Help define the team’s initial customer segments, qualification criteria, positioning, commercial approaches, and operating cadence. Bring structured customer and competitive feedback to Product and Engineering, influencing what we build and how we bring it to market. Turn early wins into repeatable playbooks while remaining hands-on in prospecting, deal execution, and customer launches. Who you are We’re looking for a seller who combines a hunter’s drive with a builder’s mindset. You’re motivated by ambitious targets, but equally interested in understanding how a product works and why a customer should adopt it. You can earn credibility with technical founders, navigate complex organizations, and make progress when the product, market, and sales motion are evolving. If you meet the minimum requirements, we encourage you to apply. Preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a prerequisite. Requirements 5+ years of customer-facing experience in technology, fintech, crypto, payments, or financial infrastructure, with a track record of strong commercial performance. Demonstrated success generating your own pipeline and winning net-new business. Experience leading complex, consultative sales involving multiple stakeholders and customized commercial agreements. Ability to become a trusted advisor to senior business leaders while engaging credibly with product and technical teams. Strong commercial judgment and the ability to connect a customer’s business model, money flows, and product strategy to a compelling solution. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain unfamiliar technical concepts clearly. Comfort operating with autonomy, navigating ambiguity, and building processes rather than relying on an established playbook. A collaborative approach and a willingness to take ownership of the work required to help customers succeed. Preferred qualifications Experience selling to AI-native companies, developer platforms, fintechs, wallets, or crypto-native businesses. Experience with stablecoins, issuance, treasury, cross-border payments, or embedded finance. Experience selling API-based infrastructure or bringing regulated financial products to market. Experience as an early or founding seller who helped build a new product’s go-to-market motion. Familiarity with agentic commerce and the financial infrastructure needs of AI-driven businesses.
